title: Roleplay-doh: Enabling Domain-Experts to Create LLM-simulated Patients via Eliciting and Adhering to Principles
reasoning: The paper focuses on a human-LLM collaboration pipeline for improving the realism of simulated patient roleplay in the context of counselor training. While it includes an ethics statement regarding research conduct and compensation, it does not evaluate religion, theology, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
